mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) triggers immediate market concerns about aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, depressing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST < 700 and RSAFS < 400000 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as earnings growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening supply chain activity and economic output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines fail to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 700) signal a cooling housing market, triggering immediate negative sentiment about broader economic weakness and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 700.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as market participants anticipate sustained easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, depressing consumer confidence and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
